scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2 (General States), Chapter 4: ADPs on Banach Space. Eventually contracting maps and geometric convergence (Theorem 4.1.1); normalized order units, sup-nonexpansive norms (Proposition A.5.23) and Blackwell's condition (Lemma 4.1.2, Theorem 4.1.3, Exercises 4.1.1-4.1.2); discount operators, the spectral radius in Gelfand form, order contractions and order contracting ADPs (Theorems 4.1.4-4.1.8, Exercises 4.1.3-4.1.4, A.4.2); Du's theorem in Banach lattices with Lemma 4.1.9 and Theorem 4.1.11; applications: firm valuation with constant and state-dependent discounting and with integrable profits in L1 (Propositions 4.2.1-4.2.2), a real option problem in L1 (Exercises 4.2.2-4.2.3, Proposition 4.2.3), and structural estimation with post-action value functions, state-dependent discounting and certainty equivalents (Exercises 4.2.4-4.2.5, Propositions 4.2.4-4.2.6); with the earlier chapters' models, ADP theory and the Banach lattice bX restated.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 2: General States, Chapter 4, pp. 123-146, with the Appendix A results used there.
